wechat-superbench.coverage: article body captured in full; chart images not read

deliverable: A source-grounded comparison of two Chinese LLM evaluation reports: what each measures, which numbers each reports, and what their differences do and do not license.

turns.text: Using only these two evaluation reports, compare what each measures: name the evaluation systems, categories and any reported scores, citing each article by section.
Focus on the gap between domestic and international models. What does each report claim, with which numbers, and do the two reports measure the same thing when they say "gap"?
Synthesize what a reader can and cannot conclude from these two reports about Chinese LLM capability in 2024. Distinguish agreement between the reports from claims only one report supports.

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report says it covers general capability with a multi-dimension scheme of science, humanities and Hard tracks, that all items are newly written, and that the total is 3226 multi-turn short-answer questions.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: 2. SuperCLUE测评体系及数据集说明
reference_facts.quote: 本次8月报告聚焦通用能力测评，采用多维度、多层次的综合性测评方案，由理科、文科和Hard三大维度构成。题目均为原创新题，总量为3226道多轮简答题。

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report states that the general-capability gap between the top domestic and top international models kept narrowing, from 30.12% in May 2023 to 1.29% in August 2024.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: 一、关键进展与趋势
reference_facts.quote: 国内外第一梯队大模型在中文领域的通用能力差距在持续缩小，从2023年5月的30.12%的差距，缩小至2024年8月的1.29%

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report reports a Pearson correlation of 0.89 with a P value of 2.46e-07 between SuperCLUE scores and Chatbot Arena scores, presented as evidence that its automated ranking agrees with human anonymous voting.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: 16. 评测与人类一致性验证
reference_facts.quote: 将SuperCLUE得分与ChatBotArena得分进行相关性计算，得到皮尔逊相关系数：0.89，P值：2.46e-07

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report describes a human re-review of 100+ sampled items for each of five models and reports per-model reliability of 88.68% to 97.64%, averaging 94.62%, which it uses to argue its automated scoring is reliable.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: 16. 评测与人类一致性验证

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report grades domestic models by a maturity index: exact instruction following is the only extremely-low-maturity capability with an index below 0.7, while computation, code, long text and high-order reasoning sit in the low band of 0.7 to 0.8.
reference_facts.quote: 极低成熟度指的是大多数模型无法胜任。SC成熟度指数在0.7以下。当前国内大模型低成熟度的能力是【精确指令遵循】。

reference_facts.claim: The SuperCLUE August report says GLM-4-9B-Chat scored 61.15, the highest among models under 10B parameters and the only domestic model in that class above 60, while Gemma-2-9b-it scored 60.93 to lead overseas models of the same size.
reference_facts.quote: GLM-4-9B-Chat取得61.15分，取得10B以内模型最高分，并且是国内10B以内唯一超过60分的模型。

reference_facts.claim: The SuperBench article says the framework covers five evaluation categories, semantics, code, alignment, agent and safety, with 28 sub-categories, in order to assess model capabilities comprehensively rather than through a single leaderboard score.
reference_facts.quote: 为了全面地评估大模型的各项能力，SuperBench评测体系包含了语义、代码、对齐、智能体和安全等五个评测大类，28个子类。

reference_facts.claim: The SuperBench article opens by criticising the many uneven Chinese evaluation leaderboards and states its quality criteria for a good evaluation method: openness, dynamism, scientific soundness and authority.
reference_facts.quote: 我们认为，好的评测方法应当具备开放性、动态性、科学性和权威性。

reference_facts.claim: In SuperBench's semantics evaluation on ExtremeGLUE, Claude-3 scored 76.7 and took first place, while domestic models GLM-4 and 文心一言4.0 beat the GPT-4 series to take second and third, still about 3 points behind Claude-3.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: PART/ 1 语义评测
reference_facts.quote: 其中Claude-3得分为76.7，位居第一；国内模型GLM-4和文心一言4.0则超过GPT-4系列模型位居第二和第三位，但是和Claude-3有3分差距。

reference_facts.claim: In SuperBench's code evaluation, the article says domestic models still lag clearly behind the international frontier on code writing, and that even the best model's first-pass rate is only about 50%, making code generation a major challenge.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: PART/ 2 代码评测
reference_facts.quote: 即使是表现最好的模型在代码的一次通过率上仍只有50%左右，代码生成任务对目前的大模型来说仍是一大挑战。

reference_facts.claim: In SuperBench's agent evaluation on AgentBench, the article states that domestic models as a whole lag clearly behind the international frontier, that Claude-3 and the GPT-4 series hold the top three places, and that most current models still lack strong agent capability.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: PART/ 4 智能体评测
reference_facts.quote: 在作为智能体能力评测中，国内模型整体明显落后于国际一流模型

reference_facts.claim: In SuperBench's safety evaluation on SafetyBench, the article reports that domestic model 文心一言4.0 beat the GPT-4 series and Claude-3 to the highest score of 89.1 points.
reference_facts.locator: blk-body-0001 | section: PART/ 5 安全评测
reference_facts.quote: 国内模型文心一言4.0表现亮眼，力压国际一流模型GPT-4系列模型和Claude-3拿下最高分（89.1分）

acceptable_partial_outcomes: Both reports predate later model releases; do not extend their conclusions to newer models.
Leaderboard tables that exist only as images were not read; answers must not invent unquoted rows.

reference_review.method: every quote sliced from the stored snapshot and re-checked as a literal substring
